steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Choose left and right pipettes (none, p20 single, p300 single, or p1000), select pipetting mode (single pipette alone, two pipettes independent, or two pipettes multitasking), specify source and destination labware from the provided dropdown lists, set aspiration and dispense flow rates, and decide whether to use filtered or standard tips.

steps.title: Load and parse CSV file
steps.instruction: Load the input CSV file (e.g., https://opentrons-protocol-library-website.s3.amazonaws.com/custom-README-images/355b30/csv_example.csv) and read each row to obtain source location, destination location, and transfer volume for every transfer.

steps.title: Determine pipette for each transfer
steps.instruction: For each transfer, select a pipette whose volume range includes the transfer volume: p20 for 1‑20 µL, p300 for 20‑200 µL, p1000 for 100‑1000 µL. If the appropriate pipette is unavailable, use the next smaller pipette. If a selected pipette cannot accommodate the volume (e.g., 10 µL with p300 or p1000), the protocol will raise an error before the OT‑2 run starts.

steps.title: Prepare tip racks and labware
steps.instruction: Load the chosen tip racks (filtered or standard) onto the OT‑2 deck, and load the source and destination labware according to the selections made in step 1.

steps.title: Perform liquid transfers
steps.instruction: For each CSV row, use the selected pipette to aspirate the specified volume followed by an air‑gap, split the transfer into equal‑volume sub‑transfers if aspiration volume + air‑gap exceeds tip capacity, dispense into the destination well, then execute a blow‑out, perform a tip‑touch to remove residual droplets, and finally discard the tip.
